description: This Java source file defines the class WorkEffortPartyAssignmentServices, which provides service methods related to workflow engine interactions for work effort party assignments in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods to update workflow statuses such as accept, complete, or decline assignments related to work efforts.

classes.name: WorkEffortPartyAssignmentServices
classes.description: Service class providing workflow-related operations for work effort party assignments, including status updates for activities within the workflow.

methods.name: updateWorkflowEngine
methods.description: Updates the workflow status of a work effort assignment based on the provided status ID. Handles accept, complete, and decline actions by invoking corresponding workflow engine services.
